BiblicalUsage: Chezeq is help and strength, and it stands once, in the first verse of the psalm where David calls the Lord his strength. The word is the cry of a man who has found his help in God alone, and it opens a psalm of deliverance from every enemy.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe strength is not something I find in myself but Someone I run to, and David's first word in the psalm is mine too.
